register.policyBody:
We only collect your account name and sign-in credentials where necessary to provide the service. We never sell your personal data or share it with unrelated third parties.
You can review, update or delete your profile at any time in system settings; after account deletion, related data is cleared within a reasonable period.
This demo stores registrations in server process memory only, which is wiped on restart. Please do not use a real password.
